sections.title: Entry points
sections.body: Public pages and hash routes are composed in `src/main.jsx`. Public copy and Ben’s contact links live in `src/content.js`. The optional legacy owner demo is in `src/components/OwnerPanel.jsx`.

sections.title: Class rehearsal
sections.body: The private Worker uses portal/server/handler.mjs for HTTP and trusted sign-in, portal/server/service.mjs for role checks and atomic event writes, portal/server/model.mjs for billing and consent, portal/assets/app.js for the screens, and portal/drizzle for database migrations. Run npm ci, npm test and npm run build inside portal/. Class-night operations are in portal/CLASS-NIGHT.md.
